newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - AEX trend seen continuing neutral.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - AEX trend seen continuing neutral.

text.p: The AEX index of 25 major Dutch stocks is mainly expected to continue to trade sideways although technical analysts on Monday expressed differing opinions on the AEX's likely direction when it pulls out of its current phase.
"Current market technicals, indicating that the general short term trend is down, express a short term selling condition," ING Barings said in an investment note.

"The intermediate term trend is still up," said Fibonacci Press. "We expect more time, and some backing and filling will be needed before the uptrend resumes." The AEX index finished at 550.99 points last Friday, down from 560.73 a week earlier.

ABN AMRO - The AEX has entered a phase of searching for support on the very short time frame. In the coming days we expect the index to consolidate around the 552 level, after which a suitable moment to re-enter long positions will be presented again. If not, expect the AEX to attack the support around the 546 level. Below that final support upward potential deteriorates quickly.
For now, we advise to stay neutral due to the high volatile character of the index on the daily charts.

ING Barings - The AEX has fallen below first support at 555, further weakening its internal technicals. The index has also crossed below the levels of its short term moving averages, which is an indication that the stock market is losing much of its previous bullishness.

Market momentum confirms this rather bearish stance. The momentum inidcator of the AEX has issued a bearish signal, as the fast momenutum line has fallen below the 0-line. Current market technicals, indicating that the general short term trend is down, express a short term selling condition.
Current chart readings suggest that the downward trend may continue for a while. We expect a weak market in the next few weeks, though it is possible that we first may see a rebound.

Fibonacci Press - The intermediate trend is still up. The AEX dived under 554 last week and neutralised the short term trend. We expect more time, and some backing and filling will be needed before the uptrend resumes.

First important support at 550 was reached, so at least some upside is now expected. We do not know if next support at 544 will be needed before the market turns to the upside. Only if 540 is broken, more downside action is expected.
IRIS - Breaking support at 555.75 last Friday neutralised the short-term uptrend. We expect a more or less sideways pattern in the coming week.
A drop below the 546 support level will trigger a sell signal which can take the index all the way down to 510 again. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax 31 20 504 5040
